subject: Final-mile traction playbook and risk bulletin
messages:
From: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.ai>
To: Samantha Li <samantha.li@acme-corp.com>, Acme Procurement <procure@acme-corp.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-04-27T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Final-mile traction playbook and risk bulletin

Samantha / Acme team,

Attached is an updated mutual action plan (MAP_v3.xlsx) and a short slip-risk log (SLIP_RISK_LOG.csv) summarizing the final-mile blockers we discussed on Friday. Key points:

- Procurement gating: internal vendor review still outstanding; Acme indicated a 1-week delay in vendor assessment.
- Security evidence: PKI/KMS screenshots required to satisfy internal audit — we attached the SLA exception form for you to route to security if helpful.
- Cutover window: our original close target (5/7) is tight given these items. We propose a contingency target of 5/20 if procurement pushes the PO date beyond 5/10.

Asks:
1) Please confirm the expected date for PO approval and whether Acme can commit to prioritizing vendor review this week.
2) If procurement needs an exec-level note from our side (short decision memo + evidence pack), tell us what you need and we’ll produce it today.
3) Confirm whether a short credit/extension (30 days) is acceptable to the procurement team if the PO moves past 5/10.

I attached: MAP_v3.xlsx, SLIP_RISK_LOG.csv, redwood-sla-exception-form.pdf (attachment stubs).

Next steps: if we don’t get a firm PO date by EOD 4/28 we’ll run the contingency cadence outlined on tab 4 of the MAP and loop in executive sponsors.

Thanks — Alex

--
Alex Martinez
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
alex.martinez@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0123

[Attachment: MAP_v3.xlsx] [Attachment: SLIP_RISK_LOG.csv] [Attachment: redwood-sla-exception-form.pdf]

From: Samantha Li <samantha.li@acme-corp.com>
To: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.ai>, Acme Procurement <procure@acme-corp.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-04-28T08:47:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Final-mile traction playbook and risk bulletin

Alex — thanks for the package and for consolidating. Quick update from procurement/security side:

- Vendor assessment: internal vendor review team pushed our request into the next queue; earliest completion they can commit to right now is 2026-05-10. That delays a PO until ~2026-05-14 (assuming no further follow-ups).
- Security evidence: we received the SLA exception form; security wants an explicit data flow diagram and KMS access control snapshot before they sign off — can you provide those in the next 24 hours?
- Executive approval: procurement can accept a short extension if we get a clear list of deliverables and a firm cutover commitment from Redwood.

If Redwood can provide the requested evidence today and sign an updated MAP with a 5/20 fallback, procurement will prioritize the vendor review as much as possible. I can’t promise PO before 5/14, unfortunately.

— Samantha
Vendor Program Manager, Acme Corporation
Samantha.li@acme-corp.com

From: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-04-28T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Final-mile traction playbook and risk bulletin (internal mitigation plan)

Team — summary and recommended mitigation path based on Samantha’s note. I’ve attached a redline of MAP_v3 (tab: mitigation) and exported the quick risk snapshot.

Proposed immediate actions (short form):
- A1: Produce data flow diagram + KMS access control snapshot (owner: Grace) — deliver by 2026-04-28 18:00 PT.
- A2: Prepare 1-page decision memo for Acme execs outlining business impact and request for 30-day grace (owner: Alex) — deliver by 2026-04-28 16:00 PT.
- A3: Commit to a firm cutover window 05/18-05/20 if PO is received by 05/14; otherwise, move to fallback window 05/25-05/27. (owner: Ben/Jonas)

Compact risk log (excerpt):
- RISK-01 | Procurement queue delay | Impact: PO slip to 05/14+ | Likelihood: High | Mitigation: exec note + procurement chase (A2) | New target: 05/20 fallback
- RISK-02 | Security evidence gap | Impact: security hold | Likelihood: Medium | Mitigation: produce diagrams + screen grabs (A1) | New target: 04/28 delivery
- RISK-03 | Cutover resource conflict | Impact: cross-team schedule slip | Likelihood: Medium | Mitigation: pre-block calendars and optional weekend window (A3) | New target: 05/18-05/20

If we complete A1 and A2 today, we can get procurement to prioritize on 04/29 and possibly pull PO forward to 05/10-05/12. I’ll upload the evidence pack to the drive link and ping Samantha directly after A1 is posted.

Grace O'Connor
Customer Success Manager, Redwood Inference
grace.oconnor@redwood.ai

[Attachment: MAP_v3_redline.xlsx] [Attachment: SLIP_RISK_LOG.csv]

From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
To: Samantha Li <samantha.li@acme-corp.com>
Cc: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-04-29T16:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Final-mile traction playbook and risk bulletin — exec escalation 

Samantha — thank you for the transparency. We’ve completed the evidence pack and the 1-page decision memo; both are attached and live at the drive link. Two asks before we proceed:

1) Can procurement confirm by 2026-04-30 EOD whether Acme will accept the proposed 05/20 fallback window if PO clears by 05/14? We need a binary yes/no to finalize resource bookings and potential credits.
2) If procurement cannot commit to PO by 05/14, will Acme accept a short credit (1-month) or a rollback clause tied to an agreed SLA threshold? If so please point us to the right signatory.

For transparency to execs: we are prepared to offer a one-time 30-day extension credit (internal approval in place) but need a written procurement acknowledgement to proceed. There is a DocuSign envelope open — link below — to formalize the extension and the cutover commitment.

DocuSign (envelope): https://docusign.com/envelope/example-ACME-42

I’ll hold off on booking the final cutover until we get a clear PO/acknowledgement. If we don’t hear back by 04/30 EOD I’ll escalate to our VP of Sales to request an exception on the credit.

Thanks — Jonas
VP, Sales Operations (acting), Redwood Inference
jonas.weber@redwood.ai
